searchText: I noticed `Nimbus EL` is reporting with the same client code we had expected nimbus CL to report with in graffiti watermarking, which is kind of a collision given the order in watermarks wasn't guaranteed... We probably need to make them unique if we want the EL/CL order on watermarks to be not important, as atm in devnet6 it kind of looks like 2 CL's in the watermark `lighthouse-nimbusel-1 NB94LH0d` sure, well, Nimbus is following https://github.com/ethereum/execution-apis/blob/v1.0.0-beta.7/src/engine/identification.md#clientcode but that list can be changed I've not seen any Nimbus CL blocks including it at all, but i did notice the nimbus-el on testnet yes, Nimbus _EL_ is because it's in the execution API specs so the NB I can always treat as Nimbus EL? NB was originally listed as the nimbus CL is all. Well, practically right now. Currently by default Nimbus CL would use it absent any other allocation if we, e.g., merge https://github.com/status-im/nimbus-eth2/pull/8620 (which I need to look at again, it's probably alright) it'd be a collsion if CL and EL are both using it... so maybe the answer is CL uses a different code... that's one option, yes. The EL could change its code, also, either way. I do agree they should be distinct **ACDT <t:1783346400:R>** Agenda: <https://github.com/ethereum/pm/issues/2144> Zoom: <https://ethereumfoundation.zoom.us/j/88479308162?pwd=9XvtF4kjIfZ42rQrvySQLJPu9bLz7u.1>

I noticed `Nimbus EL` is reporting with the same client code we had expected nimbus CL to report with in graffiti watermarking, which is kind of a collision given the order in watermarks wasn't guaranteed...
We probably need to make them unique if we want the EL/CL order on watermarks to be not important, as atm in devnet6 it kind of looks like 2 CL's in the watermark `lighthouse-nimbusel-1 NB94LH0d`

excerpts.author: tersec
excerpts.content: sure, well, Nimbus is following https://github.com/ethereum/execution-apis/blob/v1.0.0-beta.7/src/engine/identification.md#clientcode but that list can be changed
